en.quote: …[if vaccination rates continue] the country will achieve herd immunity in August 2021.
en.head: The reported immunity level was only 53.7% by December.
en.body: Golikova expected herd immunity by August 2021 if the vaccination pace continued. In December the government task force estimated immunity at 53.7%, while Golikova had later said at least 80% was needed. The forecast did not materialise, but this does not show that its condition about vaccination pace held; the measure also changed over time.
